title: Sync preserves unreadable files in whole and incremental reads and refuses incomplete omission lists
steps: Run the live engine HTTP fixture and the real MariaDB sync fixture.
expect: An incremental read retains the previous manifest entry for an unreadable folder and still recognizes actual deletions.
A whole read retains omitted files, then a later readable deletion removes them.
A truncated omission list refuses the read before it can authorize deletion.
fence: Missing permission is unknown content, never proof of deletion.

tests: what the engine could not read
